Hi Lena / EUHealth contracts team,

Thanks again — excited to get EUHealth live. Attached are the DPA we typically execute and the SCCs questionnaire you requested. We received your initial commercial PO and want to align legal + security to avoid hold-ups. Quick asks to help us move forward: 

- Can you confirm your preferred signing flow (DocuSign order and primary signer)?
- We can provide SOC 2 Type II (redacted), SIG answers and a CAIQ; which format works best for you?
- Are you running a DPIA for this integration? If so, please share the scope/expected completion date.

Proposed timeline: if we get SCCs answers and DPA redlines by EOD Tue (25 Jul), Marissa will push a DocuSign envelope and we can target signature by the end of the week. Diego (cc) will pick up the evidence upload and security Q&A.

From: Lena Hoffman <lena.h@euhealth.co>

Cc: EUHealth Security <sec-team@euhealth.co>
Date: Fri, 22 Jul 2028 11:02:00 +0200
Subject: Re: DPA redlines + SCCs evidence request — onboarding timeline

Neha — thanks for the fast turnaround. We did a first-pass internal review and attached a marked-up DPA. Key asks from security and legal are below: 

- We need redlined DPA back with explicit references to EU SCCs (we use the 2021 standard Annex) and confirmation you will execute the SCCs annex alongside the DPA.
- Please confirm whether Redwood will accept EU-specific data residency carve-outs for certain PHI-like datasets used in analytics.
- Security needs an initial evidence bundle: SOC 2 Type II (redacted copy), answers to the CAIQ and your signed SIG-M (if available). Also a statement on encryption at rest and in transit.
- We are conducting a DPIA for the project. Could you share a brief data flow diagram and retention/erase controls so we can scope the DPIA?

We attached our redlines (EUHealth_DPA_Redlines_20280722.pdf) and the DPIA checklist. We expect legal to sign only after the SCCs/evidence review completes. Let me know the earliest you can get the items above — we are aiming to begin provisioning the test environment 2 weeks after signature.

Thanks,
Lena Hoffman
Head of Vendor Risk & Privacy | EUHealth
[Attachment: EUHealth_DPA_Redlines_20280722.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: EUHealth_DPIA_Checklist.pdf (PDF)]

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Lena Hoffman <lena.h@euhealth.co>, Neha Kapoor <neha.k@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Jul 2028 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA redlines + SCCs evidence request — onboarding timeline

Lena — copying answers inline to keep a single record. Thanks for the clear redlines and the DPIA heads-up. High level: we can support the requests below and will commit to an evidence upload + short security call. Details below.

On Fri, 22 Jul 2028 at 11:02 +0200 Lena Hoffman <lena.h@euhealth.co> wrote:
> - We need redlined DPA back with explicit references to EU SCCs (we use the 2021 standard Annex) and confirmation you will execute the SCCs annex alongside the DPA.

Yes — we can sign the EU SCCs (2021) as an annex to the DPA. Marissa is copying in legal to prepare the annexed language and minor counter-proposals.

> - Please confirm whether Redwood will accept EU-specific data residency carve-outs for certain PHI-like datasets used in analytics.

We do operate regionally and can pin customer workloads to eu-central-1 for EUHealth. For PHI-like datasets, we can restrict processing to the EU region and exclude cross-border analytics unless explicitly enabled. We'll document the configuration options for the DPIA.

> - Security needs an initial evidence bundle: SOC 2 Type II (redacted copy), answers to the CAIQ and your signed SIG-M (if available). Also a statement on encryption at rest and in transit.

Commitments:
- SOC 2 Type II (redacted) — available; I'll upload a redacted PDF to a secure S3 location and provide a time-limited link (s3://redwood-evidence/euhealth/2028/soc2-redacted.pdf).
- CAIQ + SIG — we maintain an up-to-date CAIQ and a SIG self-assessment. I will export both to XLSX/PDF and upload.
- Encryption: TLS 1.2+ in transit; AES-256 at rest for customer model cache and persisted artifacts. Key management via configurable KMS; we support customer-managed keys (Bring Your Own Key) for Dedicated/Private deployments.

> - Could you share a brief data flow diagram and retention/erase controls so we can scope the DPIA?

I attached a short SCCs answers summary and will put together a one-page data flow diagram and retention table by COB Monday (24 Jul). If helpful, I can run a 30–45 min security onboarding call next week (Wed/Thu) to walk through evidence and configuration.

Next steps I will take today/tomorrow: 
1) Upload SOC2 redacted + CAIQ + SIG self-assessment to secured S3 and share time-limited links.
2) Draft a one-page data flow + retention matrix for the DPIA.
3) Coordinate a 30–45 min security call with your team (propose Wed 09:00–11:00 CET).

Attachments: sccs-answers-summary.docx (answers summary).

Regards,
Diego Fernandez
Security Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sccs-answers-summary.docx (DOCX)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwood.com>
To: contracts@euhealth.co; Lena Hoffman <lena.h@euhealth.co>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.k@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_m@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 23 Jul 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA redlines + SCCs evidence request — onboarding timeline

Lena / EUHealth legal team — thanks for the redlines. I reviewed the attached PDF and below are the principal legal positions and routing steps so we can get to signature without re-litigating standard production controls. 

Key legal positions (high level):
- SCCs: we can incorporate the EU SCCs (2021) as an annex. We will not accept non-standard unilateral amendments that expand liability beyond contract caps; where you have proposed such language, I've added alternative wording that preserves the parties' commercial allocation of risk.
- Retention/erase: we can accept a defined retention schedule per data category with a maximum retention period of 7 years for audit/logging exceptions; otherwise we will adhere to EUHealth's retention triggers for customer data upon termination.
- Subprocessors: Redwood maintains a subprocessors list and will provide 30 days' notice before onboarding new subprocessors; for strategic changes we will route through a common approval path rather than case-by-case negotiation.

Signature routing proposed: 
1) EUHealth signs first (primary signer name/email — please confirm).
2) Redwood receives executed copy and executes via DocuSign from Marissa Cole (marissa.c@redwood.com).

If you prefer simultaneous e-signing, we can do a two-step DocuSign envelope with your signer first in the routing and Redwood second. For large enterprise deals requiring exec sign-off, we require the authorized signatory + Redwood legal (Marissa Cole) as the final signer.

I will produce an annotated DPA (attached) reflecting the positions above and a DocuSign envelope ready for your confirmation. If your legal team can confirm the intended signer name + email and whether they require company-stamped PDF (for internal compliance), we'll prepare the envelope accordingly.

Attachments: dpa-marissa-annotated.docx (annotated DPA)

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
marissa.c@redwood.com
[Attachment: dpa-marissa-annotated.docx (DOCX)]
